item.title: [PM] Psalm 23:4: You Are With Me in the Valley
item.description: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil — He is with you tonight, and His rod and staff comfort you. Scripture: Psalm 23:4 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] 2 Chronicles 20:15: The Battle Is Not Yours, But God's
item.description: Don't be afraid, and don't be dismayed because of this great multitude — the battle is not yours, but God's; stand still and watch how He works. Scripture: 2 Chronicles 20:15 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Psalm 100:4: Enter His Gates with Thanksgiving
item.description: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving — count His help today and rest tonight in His presence. Scripture: Psalm 100:4 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Philippians 4:13: I Can Do All Things Through Christ
item.description: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me — strength comes one step at a time, so do well the one thing in front of you today. Scripture: Philippians 4:13 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Psalm 42:5: Hope in God
item.description: Hope in God — speak to your own soul tonight, remind it of His help, and let praise, not despair, be the ending. Scripture: Psalm 42:5 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Isaiah 6:3: Holy Is Yahweh of Armies
item.description: Holy, holy, holy is Yahweh of Armies — His glory fills the whole earth, so go out today with reverence and peace. Scripture: Isaiah 6:3 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Psalm 103:8: Abundant in Loving Kindness
item.description: He is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness; what receives us tonight is His mercy, not our performance. Scripture: Psalm 103:8 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Malachi 3:6: He Does Not Change
item.description: He does not change — His nature, His love and His promises stand firm, so lean your whole weight on His word today. Scripture: Malachi 3:6 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] My Soul Is Stilled Like a Weaned Child
item.description: Like a weaned child resting in its mother's arms, the heart learns to be still and lean on Him tonight. Scripture: Psalm 131:2 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] One Day in Your Courts Is Better Than a Thousand
item.description: One day in His courts is better than a thousand elsewhere; even the doorkeeper's place beats the tents of the wicked. Scripture: Psalm 84:10 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] He Instructs Me in the Night
item.description: By day His counsel is crowded out by many voices; in the quiet of the night the heart wakes and is gently reminded. Scripture: Psalm 16:7 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Teach Us to Count Our Days
item.description: Moses did not ask for more days, only to count them right: a heart of wisdom begins with treasuring each day. Scripture: Psalm 90:12 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] A Very Present Help
item.description: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help, awake through this night too. Scripture: Psalm 46:1 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Hear His Loving Kindness in the Morning
item.description: Hear His loving kindness first in the morning, and He will cause you to know the step to walk. Scripture: Psalm 143:8 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] I Have Overcome the World
item.description: Peace is not found in the world; it is in Him, who has already overcome the world. Scripture: John 16:33 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] He Will Supply Every Need
item.description: God supplies according to His riches in glory, not according to the size of our lack. Scripture: Philippians 4:19 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Kept in Perfect Peace
item.description: Lean your mind steadfastly on Him tonight, and He Himself will keep your heart in perfect peace. Scripture: Isaiah 26:3 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Be Strong and Courageous
item.description: Do not wait until the fear is gone: God is with you wherever you go, so take the first step. Scripture: Joshua 1:9 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] When I Am Afraid, I Will Trust in You
item.description: Fear will come; when it does, turn like David and lean on God's faithful word tonight. Scripture: Psalm 56:3-4 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Do Not Be Weary in Doing Good
item.description: Sow today and do not give up: the harvest has its season, and the season is in God's hands. Scripture: Galatians 6:9 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Come to Me, and I Will Give You Rest
item.description: Labor in your hands, burden in your heart: come as you are tonight, and receive His rest before the burden lifts. Scripture: Matthew 11:28 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] He Will Make Your Paths Straight
item.description: Trust with all your heart, not halfway: acknowledge Him in each concrete step, and He will make your paths straight. Scripture: Proverbs 3:5-6 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Peace Will Guard Your Heart
item.description: Anxiety carries tomorrow tonight; prayer hands it to God — and His peace stands watch while you sleep. Scripture: Philippians 4:6-7 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Glad to Go to the House of the Lord
item.description: Worship first, then the rush: hear the invitation, rise gladly, and say to someone, let's go together. Scripture: Psalm 122:1 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] In Peace I Will Sleep
item.description: The one keeping watch through the night is not you — it is God; Yahweh alone makes you live in safety. Scripture: Psalm 4:8 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Renewed Strength for Those Who Wait
item.description: Strength is not squeezed out by gritting your teeth; it is regained in waiting — entrust your wings to His wind. Scripture: Isaiah 40:31 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] He Goes Before You
item.description: You do not have to push open the door of the unknown alone — God has already gone ahead of you, and He is waiting there for you. Scripture: Deuteronomy 31:8 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Seek First His Kingdom
item.description: Put the order of your heart back in its right place: you attend to aligning yourself with God's heart; your Father will attend to supplying all that you need. Scripture: Matthew 6:33 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] He Loves You in Silence
item.description: He will rest in His love: tonight God is not tallying your day, He is quietly beside your bed, loving you. Scripture: Zephaniah 3:17 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] The Lord Is My Shepherd
item.description: Whether you lack or not is decided not by how much you have stored up, but by whom you are following — stay close behind the Shepherd. Scripture: Psalm 23:1 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Goodness and Mercy Follow Me
item.description: His goodness and mercy are not trailing far behind; like two loyal guards, they have escorted you all the way home. Scripture: Psalm 23:6 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] All Things Work Together for Good
item.description: Not every thing is itself good, but in God's hand every thread — dark or bright — is woven into good for your life. Scripture: Romans 8:28 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Perfect Peace
item.description: Peace is not a life without storms; it is an anchor cast again into His unchanging faithfulness. Scripture: Isaiah 26:3 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Thoughts of Peace
item.description: His thoughts toward you are peace, not harm — even in Babylon, He is quietly burying hope for your future. Scripture: Jeremiah 29:11 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] His Face Toward You
item.description: His lifted face is a Father bending down to look at you — His presence is your surest peace tonight. Scripture: Numbers 6:24-26 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] My Help Comes from Yahweh
item.description: The mountain is not our hope; the Maker of the mountains is — and He walks with you into this week. Scripture: Psalm 121:1-2 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Cast Every Care on Him
item.description: Set the whole pack down, item by item — because He cares for you, steadier hands take over while you sleep. Scripture: 1 Peter 5:7 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Grace Enough
item.description: He did not remove the thorn; He gave something better — grace that is sufficient, and power made perfect in weakness. Scripture: 2 Corinthians 12:9 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Dwelling in the Secret Place
item.description: The secret place is not a shelter for emergencies, but a home you dwell in day and night. Scripture: Psalm 91:1-2 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] I Will Uphold You
item.description: His presence comes first — I am with you; then come the strengthening, the help, and the upholding hand. Scripture: Isaiah 41:10 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] My Peace I Give to You
item.description: His peace is given before circumstances change; lay the week down at His feet tonight. Scripture: John 14:27 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Be Strong and Courageous
item.description: Courage is not the absence of fear; it grows along the road, because He is with us. Scripture: Joshua 1:9 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] He Gives Sleep to His Loved Ones
item.description: Sleep is a gift; loosen the day's taut string before your head reaches the pillow. Scripture: Psalm 127:2 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] This Is the Day the Lord Has Made
item.description: Settle your joy in God's hands first; the day's events can only come second. Scripture: Psalm 118:24 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] My Presence Will Go with You
item.description: Rest does not wait for the destination; it comes because He travels the road with us. Scripture: Exodus 33:14 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Through Him Who Strengthens Me
item.description: Swap 'I can' for 'through Him, I can'; strength is daily provision, not a bonus. Scripture: Philippians 4:13 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] I Remember You on My Bed
item.description: One verse held in the heart at night feeds more than ten that slide past. Scripture: Psalm 63:6 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Those Who Wait Shall Renew Their Strength
item.description: Waiting is not idleness; strength is renewed, like an eagle soaring on the wind. Scripture: Isaiah 40:31 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] Great Is Your Faithfulness
item.description: Count three small mercies before sleep, and the heart settles. Scripture: Lamentations 3:22-23 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Trust in the Lord with All Your Heart
item.description: Lay the week's decisions before God first; acknowledge Him, and He will make the path straight. Scripture: Proverbs 3:5-6 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] His Song in the Night
item.description: By day we sing because we see grace; at night we sing because we believe grace is still there. Scripture: Psalm 42:8 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Do Not Give Up Meeting Together
item.description: A lone stick of firewood burns low; together, the fire grows strong again. Scripture: Hebrews 10:25 (WEB)

item.title: [PM] He Who Keeps You Will Not Slumber
item.description: We can sleep in peace, because He stays awake all night. Scripture: Psalm 121:3-4 (WEB)

item.title: [AM] Come to Me, All You Who Labor
item.description: Rest is not earned by getting everything done first; it is received when we come to Him first. Scripture: Matthew 11:28 (WEB)
